status: frozen after all 21 calibration applications passed, but before any candidate energy distribution, centroid, or width was inspected
purpose: Fit the mission Mn K-alpha Voigt template to each candidate's combined pixel-12 spectrum in each science ObsID, compare to the published centroid shifts and resolutions, and select at most one calibration candidate without reading a cluster event.

line_template.profile: sum of normalized Voigt profiles; WIDTH is the intrinsic Lorentzian FWHM, AREA is the normalized component area, and the fitted Gaussian FWHM is the instrumental resolution

fit.statistic: Poisson Cash statistic on fixed bins

published_targets.source: A2319 Appendix A; the paper repeats 000102000 in the prose, so the three values are assigned in chronological science-ObsID order 000101000, 000102000, 000103000

candidate_selection.score: sum of squared centroid and FWHM residuals divided by their quoted statistical variances across all three ObsIDs
candidate_selection.tie_rule: if passing candidates differ in total score by less than 1.0, select the lower-complexity candidate
candidate_selection.failure_rule: if no candidate has all six absolute statistical residuals at or below 5, stop without applying gain to a cluster sky event

claim_boundary: This development gate may select only an A2319 energy-calibration nuisance treatment.
The selection cannot use a cluster line, velocity, lensing map, halo target, or gravity score.
Passing is necessary but not sufficient to reproduce the published A2319 science analysis.
